    • getLayout

      public int getLayout(List l, int alreadyPrinted, int level, int levels)

      Return the layout to use for printing the remaining boxes in the list.

      The idea is:

      • If this is the latest level and the element has no subordinates and is not a special (I want my own box) case, or
      • If this is the first element and it has no subordinates (the elements are ordered by subordinates number) then
      Break and cluster the elements from this on.
      Parameters:
      l - The list of OrgPersons we are printing
      alreadyPrinted - The number of persons already printed
      level - The level we are printing now.
      levels - The maximum number of levels we are going to print.
      Returns:
      WIDE(0) if no grouping, the number of columns if grouping has to be made.
